move_tensor_to_device: move a PyTorch tensor to the available CUDA or CPU device non-blockingly
move_dict_of_tensors_to_device: recursively move all tensors inside a dictionary to the available device
move_list_of_tensors_to_device: recursively move all tensors inside a list to the available device
move_nested_structures_to_device: recursively move tensors in nested dicts, lists, and tuples to the available device
check_device_availability: check whether CUDA is available and default to CPU if it is not
